Headline: "Israeli strikes in Gaza kill 3 children and 6 adults, health officials say" - 18 July 2026

- Israeli strikes in Gaza City on Saturday killed at least nine Palestinians, including three children, hospital officials said.
- A strike on an apartment in the Nasr neighbourhood killed at least five people, including children between the ages of 8 and 18, said Mohammed Abu Selmiya, director of Shifa Hospital, where the bodies were taken.
- An Israeli strike in the central Gaza Strip killed an Islamic Jihad sniper named Imam Khamis Akasha Abu Brikh.
- Another strike in the north of the enclave killed Muhammad Taysir Ahmad Ubeid, a commander in Hamas' operations headquarters.
- Despite the ceasefire agreement reached in October between Israel and Hamas, Israel still carries out near-daily attacks across the territory, saying it is targeting Hamas and other militants who pose a threat.

CORROBORATION: Times of Israel liveblog 18 July 2026, 6:50 pm entry: "Nine killed in IDF strikes on Hamas operatives in Gaza City".
Named source: Mohammed Abu Selmiya, director of Shifa Hospital.
